description: Places a drafted delivery order exactly as drafted. The draftId comes from draft_delivery_order, or from place_delivery_order when the connection is set to confirm each decision. Retrying with the same draftId never creates a second order. When payment is online, the result includes a payment link to WaitApp's payment page where the guest pays; this tool charges nothing. The venue must accept the order after it is placed; track_order follows it by orderCode.
name: confirm_delivery_order
title: Confirm a drafted delivery order
